info.title: ForkCast API
info.description: REST API for ForkCast, a meal planner where users save recipes (their own or imported from TheMealDB), plan their week and get an automatic shopping list. Requests and responses are JSON. Until JWT authentication arrives in Milestone 4 the caller is identified by the temporary X-User-Id header.

get.description: Returns every category without paging. Any identified user.

post.description: Creates a category. Admins only. The name must be unique.

get.description: Returns one category. Any identified user.

put.description: Updates a category. Admins only. The name must stay unique.

delete.description: Deletes a category. Admins only. Returns 400 when the category still has recipes.

get.description: Sends exactly one filter to TheMealDB. A name search returns full meals; category, area and ingredient filters return summaries. The result list can be empty.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search by meal name. Exactly one of q, category, area or ingredient must be sent.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category. Exactly one of q, category, area or ingredient must be sent.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Filter by area. Exactly one of q, category, area or ingredient must be sent.

parameters.name: ingredient
parameters.description: Filter by ingredient. Exactly one of q, category, area or ingredient must be sent.

200.description: Matching meals: full meals for q, summaries for the other filters.

503.description: TheMealDB is unavailable. Returns the friendly message from docs/API.md.

get.description: Returns one simplified meal from TheMealDB.

503.description: TheMealDB is unavailable. Returns the friendly message from docs/API.md.

get.summary: Get a TheMealDB meal by id
get.description: Returns one simplified meal from TheMealDB.

503.description: TheMealDB is unavailable. Returns the friendly message from docs/API.md.

get.description: Returns every ingredient line of a recipe. Any identified user.

200.description: The ingredient lines of the recipe.

post.description: Adds an ingredient line to a recipe. The owner of the recipe or an admin only.

put.description: Updates one ingredient line. The owner of its recipe or an admin only.

delete.description: Deletes an ingredient line. The owner of its recipe or an admin only. Returns 400 for the last ingredient of a recipe.

get.description: Returns one page of plans. A user sees only their own plans; an admin sees every plan.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of plans to skip. Default 0.

post.description: Creates a plan for the identified user. The week start date must be a Monday and the user may have only one plan per week.

201.description: The created plan with its planned meals.

get.description: Returns one plan with its planned meals. The owner of the plan or an admin only.

200.description: The plan with its planned meals.

put.description: Updates a plan. The owner of the plan or an admin only. The week start date must be a Monday; the plan being updated does not count as an existing plan for that week.

200.description: The updated plan with its planned meals.

delete.description: Deletes a plan together with its planned meals. The owner of the plan or an admin only.

get.description: Returns the grouped ingredients of all recipes in a plan. The owner of the plan or an admin only.
Returns every planned meal of a plan, including the recipe title and image. The owner of the plan or an admin only.

200.description: The planned meals of the plan.

post.description: Adds a meal to a free slot of a plan. The owner of the plan or an admin only. The recipe must exist and one slot (day and meal type) holds one meal.

put.description: Updates a planned meal. The owner of its plan or an admin only. The meal being updated does not count as occupying its own slot.

delete.description: Deletes a planned meal. The owner of its plan or an admin only.

get.description: Returns one page of recipes. Any identified user. Optional filters can narrow the list by title, category and owner.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search on the recipe title.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: When true, only the recipes of the identified user are returned.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of recipes to skip. Default 0.

200.description: One page of recipes, without ingredient lines.

post.description: Creates a recipe with at least one ingredient in one transaction. The caller is the owner and source is "own".

201.description: The created recipe with its ingredients.

get.description: Returns one recipe with its ingredient lines. Any identified user.

put.description: Updates a recipe. The owner of the recipe or an admin only. When ingredients are sent, they replace all existing ingredients in one transaction.

200.description: The updated recipe with its ingredients.

delete.description: Deletes a recipe. The owner of the recipe or an admin only. Returns 400 when the recipe is used in a plan.

post.description: Looks up a TheMealDB meal and saves it as a recipe owned by the caller with source "mealdb". Importing the same meal twice returns the existing recipe with 200.

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: TheMealDB meal id, at most 20 characters.

200.description: The recipe that was already imported by this user.

503.description: TheMealDB is unavailable. Returns the friendly message from docs/API.md.

get.description: Returns one page of users without password hashes. Admins only.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of users to skip. Default 0.

post.description: Public registration. The created user always gets the role "user"; the client cannot choose a role.

get.description: Returns one user without the password hash. The user with that id or an admin only.

put.description: Updates a user. The user with that id or an admin only. The password is optional; only an admin may change a role.

delete.description: Deletes a user. Admins only. Returns 400 when a database constraint blocks it, for example when the user's recipes are used in other users' plans.

Error.description: Standard error response. Every error has an "error" message.

User.description: A user without the password hash.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp as stored by MySQL.

UserInput.description: User data for registration (POST) and update (PUT). The password is required on POST and optional on PUT.

password.description: Required on POST, optional on PUT. Stored with password_hash(); never returned.

role.description: Only an admin may change a role. On POST the role is always "user".

CategoryInput.description: Category data for POST and PUT.

MealPlan.description: A weekly meal plan. GET /plans/{id}, POST /plans and PUT /plans/{id} also include the planned meals in the "meals" field.

week_start_date.description: Start of the week (a Monday) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp as stored by MySQL.

meals.description: The planned meals of this plan.

MealPlanInput.description: Meal plan data for POST and PUT. user_id is always the caller and cannot be set by the client.

week_start_date.description: A valid date that is a Monday, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only one plan per user per week.

PlannedMeal.description: A meal placed in one slot of a plan. List responses also include the recipe title and image.

recipe_image_url.description: Included in list responses only; may be null.

PlannedMealInput.description: Planned meal data for POST and PUT. plan_id comes from the route and cannot be set by the client. One meal per slot (day and meal type).

ShoppingItem.description: One grouped ingredient of a plan shopping list.

measures.description: Distinct measures for this ingredient joined with ", ". May be null when no measures were recorded.

times_used.description: How many planned meals use this ingredient.

Recipe.description: A recipe stored by a user. Single-recipe responses include the ingredient lines in the "ingredients" field; list responses do not.

instructions.example: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.

image_url.description: Optional valid URL; may be null.

external_id.description: TheMealDB id, present on imported recipes; may be null.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp as stored by MySQL.

author_first_name.description: First name of the recipe owner.

author_last_name.description: Last name of the recipe owner.

ingredients.description: The ingredient lines of the recipe.

RecipeInput.description: Recipe data for POST and PUT. user_id, source and external_id are set by the backend and cannot be sent by the client.

instructions.example: Cook the pasta until al dente and serve it with the sauce.

image_url.description: Optional valid URL, at most 500 characters.

ingredients.description: At least one ingredient. Required on POST; optional on PUT, where a list replaces all existing ingredients.

Ingredient.description: One ingredient line of a recipe.

IngredientInput.description: Ingredient data for POST and PUT. recipe_id comes from the route for POST /recipes/{id}/ingredients.

ExternalMeal.description: A simplified meal from TheMealDB, returned by name search, random and lookup.

thumbnail.description: Image URL from TheMealDB; may be null.

tags.description: Tags split from the comma separated TheMealDB value; empty when there are none.

ExternalMealSummary.description: A compact TheMealDB meal returned by the category, area and ingredient filters.

thumbnail.description: Image URL from TheMealDB; may be null.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input or a business rule is violated.

Unauthorized.description: No identified user: the X-User-Id header is missing or does not match an existing user.

Forbidden.description: The caller is not allowed to perform this action.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

tempUser.description: Temporary identification until JWT (Milestone 4). Use 1 for the admin, 2 for a user.
tempUser.name: X-User-Id

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Registration and user accounts. An admin lists and deletes users; a user or an admin reads and updates one account.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Recipe categories. Any identified user reads them; only an admin creates, updates or deletes one.

tags.name: Recipes
tags.description: Recipes owned by users, including recipes imported from TheMealDB.

tags.name: Meal plans
tags.description: Weekly meal plans and their shopping lists.

tags.name: Planned meals
tags.description: Meals placed in a plan slot (day and meal type).

tags.name: External
tags.description: Read-only access to TheMealDB for searching, looking up and picking random meals.
